item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 10/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Mulan will move towards the vicinity of western Guangdong and Hainan Island, and intensify gradually today. Under the influence of its outer rainbands, it will be windy with heavy squally showers and thunderstorms over the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. Seas will be very rough with swells. A broad trough of low pressure will continue to bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea in the latter part of this week. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening slightly, the weather will improve over southeastern China early next week.
